description: Detailed report on one x402 vendor from Lumi's trust list: full observation history (every free 402-quote check over 90 days, every paid test-buy with tx hash and delivered yes/no), latency stats and 7-day trend, uptime % (24h/7d/30d/90d) and daily series, quoted-price history, agent reports, vendor replies, sample sizes and confidence labels. Automated observations, not a rating. Paid: $0.02 per call (USDC on Base, or XRP/RLUSD/USDC on the XRP Ledger). The free summary is lumi_vendor_scores. Pays with your own wallet via x402 (XRPL_SEED or EVM_PRIVATE_KEY) within the configured caps.
